headline: Nigerian Entrepreneurs Win Contracts for 109 Solar Mini Grids
meta_description: Two Nigerian entrepreneurs have won contracts to build 109 solar mini grids, bringing reliable electricity to over 230,000 homes and businesses.
summary_short: Two Nigerian entrepreneurs secure contracts to build 109 solar mini grids that will nearly double electricity access for more than 230,000 homes and businesses.
body:
Two Nigerian entrepreneurs have won contracts to build 109 solar mini grids, a major step toward expanding electricity access across the country. The projects will bring reliable power to more than 230,000 homes and businesses combined.

The scale of this initiative is significant: the 109 mini grids will nearly double the current capacity of similar installations in the region. By distributing energy generation through smaller, localized systems rather than relying on centralized infrastructure, these entrepreneurs are addressing a critical gap in energy access that affects millions of Nigerians.

Solar mini grids represent a practical solution for rural and underserved areas where traditional grid expansion remains slow or prohibitively expensive. This contract award demonstrates growing momentum in Nigeria's renewable energy sector and the potential for locally-driven solutions to tackle the continent's energy challenges.
quick_facts: Two Nigerian entrepreneurs won contracts for solar mini grid projects
109 solar mini grids will be built across Nigeria
Over 230,000 homes and businesses will gain electricity access
Projects will nearly double existing solar mini grid capacity
